Deed: **Came home.** Ended the battle on their feet or evacuated (a downed fighter who was evacuated counts; one left behind or captured does not)
**Put one down.** Each enemy fighter or monster the fighter's attack put down (the attack that decided it), up to 2 a battle. A rival is worth 1 more (section 14.8)
**Did the job.** Credited with the scenario's winning condition
